_README: Single source of truth for the calendar. 'recurring' events generate themselves forever, so the site never goes stale. Add confirmed one-off dates to 'dated'. 'annual' holds the season anchors whose dates are set each year. See how-to-update-events.md.

recurring.title: Kars & Koffee
recurring.address: 9423 N Fort Washington Rd, Fresno, CA 93730
recurring.blurb: Our monthly morning meet. Coffee, cars, and whoever shows up. All makes are welcome, so bring the BMW or bring the thing you are actually working on.

annual.title: Euro Car Show
annual.address: Entrance on International between Willow and Chestnut, Clovis, CA
annual.blurb: The chapter's own show. Awards across multiple categories, open to European makes, run by the board and chapter volunteers.
annual.alt: A Porsche, a red BMW and a blue coupe parked in a row at a Central California chapter show

annual.title: High Performance Driving School
annual.address: Buttonwillow, CA, run with the San Diego chapter
annual.blurb: Two days of instructed track time with the San Diego chapter. Classroom sessions, an assigned instructor, and real lapping time in your own car.
annual.alt: A white BMW E36 race car with a rear wing parked alongside other chapter cars

annual.title: Legends of the Autobahn
annual.blurb: The national German-car concours during Monterey Car Week. Chapter members caravan over from the valley every year.
annual.cost: Admission packages sold through BMW CCA
annual.alt: Chapter BMWs parked together in a club corral at a racetrack

annual.title: Kars & Koffee Toy Drive
annual.address: 9423 N Fort Washington Rd, Fresno, CA 93730
annual.blurb: The last meet of the year. Same time and place as any Kars & Koffee, except everyone brings a toy to donate to Valley Children's Hospital.
annual.alt: A red BMW M3 parked at a Cen Cal chapter meet with members talking in the background
